A course only goes live when its curriculum is complete, so you never enrol into an unfinished outline.
The platform works fully in Arabic and English, including navigation, course pages and the learning player.

faqs.q: How do I start a course?
faqs.a: Open the course page and choose Enrol. The course then appears in My Learning, and the learning player opens at the first lesson.
Yes. Each lesson you mark complete is stored with the course, so the player reopens exactly where you stopped.

faqs.q: Can I learn on my phone?
faqs.a: Yes. The catalogue, course pages and the learning player are all built for small screens as well as desktop.

faqs.q: How do I change my email or password?
faqs.a: Go to account settings. Email changes are confirmed with a one-time code sent to the new address.
Adding a course to your wishlist lets you keep track of courses you are interested in before enrolling. It does not enrol you.
Free courses are labelled Free on the course card and on the course page. You still need an account to enrol.
Request a refund within 30 days of enrolment, as long as you have not completed most of the lessons.

faqs.q: When do I get a certificate?
faqs.a: A certificate is issued automatically once every lesson in the course is marked complete. It appears on your certificates page.
Yes. Open it from the certificates page — it includes the course name, your name and the completion date.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms explain what you can expect from the platform and what we expect from you when you use it.

sections.p: You need an account to enrol in a course. Keep your sign-in details private — anything done through your account is treated as done by you.
Provide accurate details when you register and keep them up to date. We may suspend accounts used to share paid content or to disrupt other learners.
Courses are licensed to you for personal learning. You may not redistribute, resell, or publish lesson material, downloads, or assessments.
Paid courses are charged before access is granted. Prices shown at checkout include any applicable taxes.
You can request a refund for a paid course within 30 days of enrolment, provided you have not completed the majority of its lessons.
If we change these terms in a way that affects your rights, we will tell you before the change takes effect.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes what data the platform stores, why it is stored, and the control you have over it.

sections.p: Account details you provide (name, email, phone), your enrolment and progress records, and basic technical data needed to keep the service running.
To give you access to your courses, save your progress, issue certificates, and contact you about your account.
We do not sell personal data. Data is shared only with the providers that operate parts of the service, such as payment processing.
Enrolment and certificate records are kept while your account is active. You can ask us to delete your account and its data.
You can view and edit your details from account settings at any time, and request an export or deletion of your data.
For any privacy question, use the contact page and we will respond to you directly.
